item.title: Three Type Systems and Runtimes — JVM, CPython, and the Go Compiler
item.description: Java pairs static strong typing with JVM bytecode and adaptive JIT optimization. Python combines dynamic typing with an interpreter and declarative type hints. Go ships static structural typing and a single compiler. The type-system decision drives the runtime mechanism.
